directories.src: Contains 4 module files (constants.ts, models.ts, plugin.ts, types.ts)

README.md.summary: This README file documents the `opencode-kiconnect` plugin, detailing its architecture and integration with the KI:connect gateway for accessing sovereign and commercial LLMs. It serves as the primary project documentation and usage guide.

index.ts.summary: This file serves as the project's main entry point, re-exporting `plugin` as the default export to expose the core functionality for consumers.

package.json.summary: This file defines the project metadata, dependencies, and build scripts for the `opencode-kiconnect` plugin. It serves as the npm configuration and entry point definition for the OpenCode AI integration project.

src/constants.ts.summary: `src/constants.ts` defines configuration constants, environment variables, and `MODEL_ALIASES` for the KI:connect provider integration. It supplies default metadata and mapping values across the project.

scripts/generate_benchmarks_graph.py.summary: `scripts/generate_benchmarks_graph.py` generates benchmark visualization charts using `matplotlib`. It serves as a reporting script to visually compare performance scores across various AI models.

src/models.ts.summary: `src/models.ts` defines the curated model catalog via `KICONNECT_DEFAULT_MODELS`. It configures active AI models for the OpenCode model picker and maps them to upstream gateway identifiers.

src/plugin.ts.summary: `src/plugin.ts` manages API key persistence and configuration file operations for the plugin. It exports `readApiKeyFromConfigFile`, `saveApiKeyToConfigFile`, and `readApiKeyFromDotenv` to handle credential storage.

tsconfig.build.json.summary: This TypeScript configuration file defines the production build settings, overriding base rules to output compiled JavaScript and declarations to the `dist` directory for project distribution.

src/types.ts.summary: This file defines TypeScript interfaces (`ModelLimit`, `ModelModalities`, `KIConnectModelDefinition`, and `KIConnectConfigFile`) that establish the configuration and data structures for model limits, modalities, and connections across the project.
